messages:
Priya S: Heads up — PR #51234 touches KMS wrapping in runtime routing and also the batch eviction path. Need runtime + security eyes before we merge. Targeting a canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC. @Alex M @Jin C any capacity to review?

Priya S: CI is failing a flaky kv eviction test — log snippet below. I can try a quick test tweak but would prefer runtime to confirm root cause.
```
FAIL tests/test_kv_eviction.py::test_eviction_race - AssertionError: expected 2 got 3
thread: runtime/evict -> race detected at 0x7ff
```

Alex M: I can take a look tonight. Can you paste minimal repro steps? Also does this affect any quantized kernel paths or just eviction logic? :mag:

Priya S: Minimal repro: `./scripts/run_kv_eviction --seed=42 --iters=50` — repros ~1/10 locally. No kernel opcode changes in this PR, just routing + KMS envelope handling.

Jin C: Security note: because this touches KMS wrapping we need a quick KMS review (key usage + ACLs). @security-team please assign someone. Also confirm whether HSM/CloudKMS is used.

Samir: I can own the canary scheduling. We have a merge freeze window Thursday 15:00-18:00 UTC — tomorrow 09:00 UTC is clear. I’ll create a canary run and add the runtime latency SLO dashboards (p50/p99).

deploy-bot: [info] Reserved canary slot for PR #51234 on staging at 2025-08-15T09:00:00Z (slot-id: canary-51234)

Alex M: Quick thought on the test flake — looks like a race on eviction counters. Try increasing the test wait timeout to 5s and re-run CI. If it becomes stable we can investigate a deterministic fix afterwards. I’ll post a small test-only patch if that helps unblock canary.

Priya S: Sounds good. I’ll push the test timeout tweak and update the PR with repro steps + the failing CI job link. Plan: push tweak, wait for runtime + security eyes, run canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC, merge if green and security signs off.

Jin C: I’ll take KMS review and aim to finish by 22:00 UTC. If I need more info I’ll comment on the PR.

Samir: I created CANARY-1234 in ops board and added alert playbook for eviction regressions. I’ll watch the run. :white_check_mark:

Alex M: I added a small WIP test tweak in a follow-up commit on the branch and left comments on the PR about possible root causes.

Priya S: Thanks all — will ping here if anything blocks. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:
